entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse.
Okay, I can look into that for you. To get started, could you please provide your order number?
It's VF886-01. Look, I don't have a lot of time, is this returnable or not?
I understand you're busy. I just need to ask one or two questions to find the right solution. What specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's nothing wrong with it. I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it.
I see. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just pull up your order details... Okay, I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on December 19th, which was 18 days ago.
Correct. So, let's process the return.

Well, sir, for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, our policy for preference-based returns is within a 10-day window from the purchase date. Because the device activates and links to a user's health account, we can't accept it back after that period. Since we're at day 18, I'm unable to process a refund.
Ten days? Are you serious? So what am I supposed to do, just throw it away? This is ridiculous.

I definitely understand your frustration, and I can offer an alternative. We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a platform where our members can buy and sell their gently used gear directly to each other.
A resale site? Is that going to be a huge hassle?

Not at all. Since the VeloBand Pulse is in high demand, they typically sell very quickly on the marketplace, often for close to the original price. The listing process takes less than five minutes. It's the best way to recoup your cost for an item that's outside the return window.
Okay... fine. If it's really that quick. Can you send me a link?
Of course. I'm sending an email to the address on file right now with a direct link to the resale marketplace and a simple guide to get you started. You should have it within the next minute.
Alright. I see it. Thanks.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
